subject.title: fix(gateway): merge MCP schema properties by own keys

question: Should maintainers land this narrow Gateway MCP own-key schema fix after refreshing exact-head checks?
rationale: The PR carries a protected maintainer label and has a live CI shard failure/behind-base state, so cleanup automation should not close or repair it without human merge intent.

options.title: Land after exact-head gating
options.body: Keep the patch as the focused replacement and merge it after the failed shard is understood or rerun and the base is current.

options.title: Ask for fresh proof first
options.body: Require current-head real behavior proof or CI proof before merge even though the predecessor branch showed the same behavior.

options.title: Defer to warning-policy work
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the own-key fix bundled with broader MCP warning-policy consolidation.

recommendation.title: Land after exact-head gating
recommendation.body: Keep the patch as the focused replacement and merge it after the failed shard is understood or rerun and the base is current.

likelyOwner.reason: He is both assigned on the live PR and the strongest recent/original history owner for the Gateway MCP schema helper.
